has.review:
CSE-173 : SLE
Teaching: decent for learning, clears all concepts and gives exercises as hw. The thing is, sir has still some lacking of knowledge in this course as he is taking it after a long time. Sometimes he fails to give you the proper answer you need. And sometimes he just ignores or will suggest you to meet him during office hours.
Exam: gives tricky questions in mid and final. If you aren’t an exceptional you can’t answer full marks.
Grading: worst. He doesn’t curve at all. He cuts marks a lot, even for a silly mistake. As his questions are hard, many students come out with B- , C+ or C.
Sir is a bit biased. If you sit in the front row and co-operate with him in every class, he will remember you and ultimately give you a good mark, make sure you meet him during office hours for even an easy topic.
NOT RECOMMENDED. TAKE AT YOUR OWN RISK.

Try to answer questions like you’re answering someone who has little idea about java.
Detailed answers would get you marks
And when i did java, he gave us bonus marks when someone had 100% attendance. BUT there’s no 5/10% marks for attendance.
